trader_labels_custody.why_both_are_recorded: these two digests cover DIFFERENT BYTE RANGES and comparing them to each other is meaningless. Each is now named with its scope so nobody tries.

censoring_note: Six labels carry TRADER_ENDED_PRESENTED_REPLAY_STILL_WAITING with a single timeline entry at exactly the window end. Those cases record NO trader decision and are segregated from every agreement and disagreement count.

aggregates.join_note: The refuted first version joined on SESSION; see F-1 in the docstring.

asymmetric_censoring_diagnostic.question: trader-side non-decision is excluded from both numerator and denominator; bot-side non-decision is counted as a disagreement. Should it also be excluded, or is an unavailable bot a real failure that must count?
asymmetric_censoring_diagnostic.why_it_is_not_adopted: it raises the fidelity number, and a party may not adopt the reading that flatters it. This is an ALGO question, not a worker decision.

cases.force_receipt_note: REAL SNAPSHOT as of ALGO-011 section 9.3. The previous receipt claimed force was implied because the entry passed `one_minute_entry` - a v2.2 fill-price helper with zero force logic (ALGO-008 F-7). This is the actual force_snapshot recomputed at the candidate's own decision clock. WHAT IT ESTABLISHES IS REPRODUCIBILITY, NOT AGREEMENT: it re-issues the exact argument tuple the kernel already gated on and force_snapshot is pure, so it cannot come back unconfirmed. The previous version of this caption advertised a FORCE_RECEIPT_DISAGREES_WITH_KERNEL_GATE raise as a live guard; the arena grade of 2026-08-23 (F-2) proved it dead on 100% of the corpus and it is gone. The cross-check that has real power is `independent_force`, and its power is one-sided - see its own docstring.

budget_faithful.note: Only the session's FIRST fully-approved entry can execute. When it precedes the window, every in-window entry is unreachable and must not be scored as the bot's decision.
